description: Canonical crime-type taxonomy for FIR Intel. Every FIR must be classified into exactly one of these types.

crime_types.label: Cyber Fraud – KYC / Bank Executive Impersonation
crime_types.description: Caller poses as a bank executive and claims KYC, reward points or account details need to be updated. Victim is asked to install remote-access software (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) or share an OTP / APK link, after which money is transferred out of the victim's account.

crime_types.label: Fake Police / Authority Call (Digital Arrest)
crime_types.description: Caller poses as a police officer, CBI, ED, customs or other government authority and claims the victim's Aadhaar / parcel / account is linked to a crime. Victim is kept on a video call ('digital arrest') and coerced into transferring money.

crime_types.label: Job / Task-Based Scam
crime_types.description: Victim is offered a part-time or work-from-home job (data entry, task completion, etc.) via WhatsApp or Telegram. A security deposit or registration fee is collected via UPI and then the number goes dark.

crime_types.label: ATM Card Swap
crime_types.description: Accused approaches victim at an ATM booth, offers help, observes the PIN and swaps the card with a dummy card. Money is later withdrawn using the genuine card.

crime_types.label: Chain Snatching
crime_types.description: Two or more accused on a motorcycle or scooter approach the victim and snatch a gold chain or other jewellery and flee.

crime_types.label: House Burglary
crime_types.description: Accused break into a locked, unoccupied house (family away at wedding, out of town, etc.) and steal cash, jewellery, electronics or other valuables.

crime_types.label: Vehicle Theft
crime_types.description: Victim's motorcycle, scooter or other vehicle is stolen while parked – typically taken away on a loader, or the handle lock is broken.

crime_types.label: Other / Unclassified
crime_types.description: FIR does not fit any of the defined crime types above.
